purpose: Continue Elburg/Emmen/Enkhuizen/Ermelo closure work while preserving the mandatory application-document standard.

records.applicationRoute: Vergunningcheck -> conceptverzoek via Omgevingsloket where useful -> formal omgevingsvergunning via Omgevingsloket.
documentsAndDrawings: For Intaketafel: situatietekening, clear plan description, motivation, land-ownership information or owner consent.

For Omgevingsplan/quality review: current and proposed floor plans, current and proposed elevations, site plan, existing/environment photographs, appearance detail drawings, dimensions, materials and colours.
All drawings must be to scale and dimensioned.
feesAndTerm: Concept request fee 2026: EUR 255.50; partial credit if same permit follows within six months.
Regular permit: max 8 weeks; complex route max 6 months; one extension of 6 weeks possible.
remaining: direct current housing-specific room-rental/splitting substantive rule/plan article
activity-specific extra studies where generated by concrete project

records.applicationRoute: Current Omgevingsplan is the location-specific primary source; permit check and formal application run through Omgevingsloket; concept request is available before formal application.
records.qualityFinding: Search results returned unrelated parking-permit tariffs. Those are explicitly excluded from housing/omgevingsvergunning fees. No fee is copied unless it is tied to the correct activity and current 2026 tariff table.
remaining: current correct 2026 omgevingsvergunning/concept-request fees and decision term

records.futureSignal: Municipality is developing a new structured Omgevingsplan, with establishment planned around end 2026; current transitional/integrated plan remains controlling until replacement parts take effect.
records.qualityFinding: Current parking-permit information was found but is unrelated to the housing activities and therefore excluded from the legal/application dataset.
remaining: official application route and generic document/drawing package
correct activity-specific 2026 fees and decision period

records.currentLaw: Huisvestingsverordening gemeente Ermelo 2026 is confirmed current from 17-12-2025. It governs housing allocation; its explanatory text notes that the Huisvestingswet can also regulate housing-stock changes, but this 2026 regulation is principally aimed at distribution of corporation rentals and affordable new-build purchase homes. It must therefore not be misrepresented as a standalone conversion/splitting permit regime without a specific operative provision.
